title: Bank of Baroda Apprentice Result 2026 – Out
postName: Engagement of Apprentices under Apprentices Act, 1961
vacancyDetails: Apprentice engagement under Apprentices Act; result PDF lists provisionally qualified candidates (reports cite ~4771 qualified in one list)
qualification: Graduation as per Bank of Baroda Apprentice notification
selectionProcess: Online Test → Provisional Selection List → Document Verification → Engagement
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, DOB proof, category certificate, Aadhaar, photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.bankofbaroda.bank.in
2. Open Career / Current Opportunities
3. Download Apprentice Result / Final Result notification PDF
4. Search Roll Number in qualified list
5. Follow DV and engagement instructions
shortDescription: Bank of Baroda Apprentice Result 2026 released on 18 July 2026 for exam held around 21 June 2026. Download merit/selection PDF from bankofbaroda.bank.in.
content:
Bank of Baroda has released the result for Engagement of Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961.

Result was published on 18 July 2026 in PDF format containing roll numbers of provisionally selected / qualified candidates. Online test was held in June 2026.

Check Careers section on bankofbaroda.bank.in for the official PDF and further process with BFSI SSC if mentioned in notice.
